title: Restore a green Release Gate on main: close the go-jose/v3 advisory via go-oidc v3.21.0 and fix five Sonar findings
goal: Make main's Release Gate succeed again. The Dependabot Alerts job failed on one high advisory against go-jose/v3, which arrives only transitively through coreos/go-oidc v3.9.0 and has no fix on the v3 line; upgrading go-oidc to v3.21.0 moves the tree onto go-jose/v4 4.1.6. The SonarCloud Gate job failed on five unprocessed issues (go:S1135, godre:S8209, go:S3776 x2, typescript:S3776), all in files this programme touched; each is fixed by refactoring, never by suppression.
findings: Release Gate on main was red on two of its jobs: dependabot-alerts (one high advisory, GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q / CVE-2026-116587, against github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v3) and sonarcloud-gate (five unprocessed issues).

go-jose/v3 was never a direct dependency; it entered through github.com/coreos/go-oidc/v3 v3.9.0, which only moved to go-jose/v4 from v3.14 onwards. v3 has no patched release, so the only remediation is the major-line move.

go-oidc v3.21.0 keeps the v3 module path and its oidc package API, so the module's own call sites compiled unchanged; the OIDC module is still dormant (no routes, no consumers), so the upgrade has no runtime surface.
After go mod tidy, go-jose appears once in go.sum as v4.1.6 // indirect and not at all in go.mod; govulncheck reports zero vulnerabilities.

Sonar go:S3776 on tenant_isolation_smoke_test.go measured cognitive complexity 53, because eleven independent subtests lived inside one function literal. Extracting them to a table of helper functions keeps every subtest name, assertion order and fixed seed id.

Sonar go:S3776 on scope_helper_test.go came from rendering and asserting the statement SQL inside the table loop; those steps move to assertScopeSQL/carriesUint64 without changing the nil/compat/multi expectations.

Sonar typescript:S3776 on TenantList.tsx measured 16 against the 15 limit; five isAdmin || hasPerm('...') sequences were the excess. A single local can(perm) keeps the five permission booleans synchronous and stable, so useCallback dependencies do not change.
godre:S8209 flagged consecutive same-type parameters on TranslateNotFound; the combined parameter list keeps the exported name, argument order and behaviour identical.
go:S1135 flagged a TODO comment in the OIDC handler; the comment was rewritten to state the same pending work as a contract note instead of a marker.

in: Upgrade coreos/go-oidc/v3 from v3.9.0 to v3.21.0 and land go-jose/go-jose/v4 v4.1.6 as the indirect replacement
Rewrite the OIDC handler TODO comment so the pending session integration is stated without a Sonar marker
Collapse TranslateNotFound's parameters to satisfy godre:S8209
Split TestTwoTenantIsolationSmoke into a subtest table plus eleven helper functions
Extract assertScopeSQL/carriesUint64 out of the table loop in the tenant scope SQL snapshot test
Introduce can(perm) in TenantList.tsx for the five permission checks
out: Changing gate rules, workflows, Sonar configuration or adding suppressions/NOSONAR
Any change to tenant isolation, data-scope, permission or audit runtime semantics
Patching or vendoring go-jose/v3 (no fix exists on that line)
Cutting a foundation release, touching VERSION or CHANGELOG.md
Any other frontend file or historical evidence file

implementationNotes: go-oidc v3.21.0 is the first line that depends on go-jose/v4; the module path stays v3 so no import path changed.
The smoke test refactor is a pure extraction: the subtest table names are byte-identical to the old t.Run names and each helper starts with t.Helper() so failures still point at the assertion.
assertScopeSQL keeps the three-context table and the two invariants (nil renders no tenant_id predicate; compat pins 0, multi pins the claim).
can(perm) is evaluated during render only; the resulting booleans are unchanged values, so canBrowseUsers remains stable as a useCallback dependency.
Local race runs need CGO_ENABLED=1 and mingw64/bin on PATH; without them cgo.exe exits 2 and every package reports [build failed].

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Treat both gate jobs as data: reproduce the failing readout, change the smallest surface that clears it, and keep every behaviour-visible line identical.
reviewerPosture: Confirm go-jose/v3 is gone from go.mod and go.sum and the advisory surface is the only thing that moved.
Confirm the five Sonar items are genuinely refactored, with no NOSONAR, no rule exclusion and no test deletion.
Diff the extracted test helpers against the pre-refactor bodies assertion by assertion.
Confirm TenantList's permission booleans still resolve to the same values and the callback dependencies did not silently change.
Confirm no workflow, Sonar config, migration, VERSION or CHANGELOG file is in the diff.

commands: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run build
runtimeEvidence: Package-level race readout (47 ok, 0 FAIL) with the cgo invocation that made it possible
govulncheck zero-vulnerability readout and the go mod graph line proving go-jose/v4 only
Frontend lint/type-check/build readouts after the TenantList change
Before/after bodies of the five refactored units

humanGates: none — both fails are standard gate remediation; no rule, threshold or exemption changed, so maintainer touchpoint 2 was not triggered
completionChecklist: go-jose/v3 removed from the module graph; govulncheck 0
All five Sonar findings refactored with no suppression
Backend race suite and frontend lint/type-check/build green
Behaviour preserved: assertions and permission values unchanged
